reviewTitle: Headband dye stains your sheets. Lasted 9 months
reviewDescription: I bought these headphones in January 2026 and by now (September 2026) the wires have pulled free from the earbuds making them trash. The black fabric also stained several sets of my sheets ultimately resulting in me buying black silk pillow covers (which have been good for my hair and skin so I can’t really complain). I am a side sleeper and I used the headphones to listen to shows at night without disturbing my husband and they worked well for the 9 months they worked. I cleaned the band by spraying it with rubbing alcohol once a week. The band leached color onto my sheets before I started doing that so I don’t think that’s the reason for the headband dye leaking. For $13.00 I didn’t expect them to be a forever product so I’m not generally unhappy with how long they lasted. Overall since they no longer work I’m trying a different brand to see about saving other sheets from staining.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on September 24, 2026
